diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a one-shot sequence (period 0) instead of a repeating cycle with period 3 MIN. The IR specifies a cycle that repeats the body indefinitely; the candidate executes the actions once and terminates, causing the mismatch at 190000 ms where the IR expects the first cycle's 'siren.setsirenmode' action to occur.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period from 0 to 180000 (3 MIN) to match the IR cycle period. Removed the trailing delay(3 MIN) which was incorrectly acting as a terminator rather than part of a cycle body. The revised script repeats the body every 3 minutes as required.
